title: Handle failure to manually create E-Document from posted doc with no …
summary: E-Document creation now correctly reports failure when a posted document cannot be converted to an e-document instead of incorrectly showing a success message.
key_points: CreateEDocumentFromPostedDocumentPage now returns whether the e-document was actually created
The creation result is passed back through the export and processing codeunits
When creation fails, users see 'The e-document could not be created.'
Fixes the false success message when creation failed without an explicit error, for example for an unsupported document type
Posted document page extensions updated to act on the result
